verdict.rationale: Kick documents a real double-entry ledger, chart of accounts, and journal entries, but there is no evidence of a documented API for exporting the general ledger or trial balance in open formats — the openapi probe returned 404s on all candidate endpoints, and the only 'API'-like surfaces found are a GitBook docs-search MCP server and Google Sheets AI integration, neither of which expose ledger/GL data programmatically.
